## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor or cleanup
- [ ] Documentation only

## How was it tested

Describe the steps taken to verify the change works correctly.

## Checklist

- [ ] The solution builds without errors or new warnings.
- [ ] Source files contain no explanatory prose comments, only XML documentation comments.
- [ ] No trailing whitespace and no more than one consecutive blank line anywhere.
- [ ] New folders that are empty contain a `.gitkeep`.
- [ ] The README in `.github/` reflects any change to what a clone receives.
